bull.b: Durable responses after stopping immunomodulators could support rese-cel’s differentiation in autoimmune disease and strengthen its path toward registrational development, if the results are confirmed in larger controlled studies.

Progress across multiple autoimmune indications creates potential for a broader commercial opportunity and reduces reliance on one disease area, while defined registrational plans improve visibility into the company’s long-term development strategy.

Relatively modest debt provides greater financial flexibility than a highly leveraged structure and may help the company fund clinical operations without substantial interest burden, although continued losses still require external capital.

bear.b: Without approved products or recurring revenue, Cabaletta remains dependent on successful clinical execution and future financing. Widening losses indicate that commercialization is still distant and operating costs remain substantial.

Large recurring cash outflows reduce funding runway and make the company reliant on capital markets or partnerships to sustain trials. Persistent burn also increases exposure to financing conditions and potential shareholder dilution.

bear.t: Expanded share authorization raises dilution risk
bear.b: The larger share authorization improves financing flexibility but gives the company capacity to issue substantial additional equity. Future capital raises could dilute existing holders while funding ongoing losses and clinical programs.
